name: Tranquil Circle sleeps player targets for 8 sec, not 40 sec (#4325)
contract: Tranquil Circle 801205's own Description reads "Every $t2 sec, enemies within the radius enter a tranquil state, falling asleep for $850010d (8 sec vs players)." Tranquil State 850010 has SpellDuration row 64 = 40000 ms with no lower value anywhere in that row for a player-specific cap, so the 8 sec the tooltip promises against players must be enforced in code (mirroring the existing Permafrost player-duration cap in AscensionRunemasterTalents.cpp): a hostile player hit by the circle gets an 8000 ms Tranquil State, not 40000 ms.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Let the circle's first periodic tick land
SETUP: Tranquil State lands on the hostile player
DISCRIMINATING: Tranquil State is capped to 8 sec against a player, not 40 sec
